create_FSDPTrainer: create an FSDPTrainer instance with a model, TrainingArguments, and dataset for distributed training
configure_FSDPTrainer_init: configure FSDPTrainer with custom data collator, tokenizer, compute_metrics callback, and optimizers
override_create_optimizer_and_scheduler: override create_optimizer_and_scheduler in FSDPTrainer to reuse a pre-created optimizer
check_is_peft_model: check if a model is a PEFT or PeftMixedModel instance using the _is_peft_model helper
setup_FSDP_xla_v2: setup FSDP XLA v2 training by enabling xla_fsdp_v2 in the fsdp_config
